intro: Converting miles per hour (mph) to meters per second (m/s) is essential when translating measurements across automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed logs, maritime navigation, and meteorological wind reports. One miles per hour equals 0.44704 meters per second, while one meters per second equals 2.23694 miles per hour. Whether you are verifying specifications on technical drawings, reconciling international supplier data sheets, or checking everyday measurements, this calculator applies the exact NIST and BIPM conversion factor with instant table lookups and step-by-step worked examples.

faqs.question: How many meters per second are in 1 miles per hour?
faqs.answer: There are 0.44704 meters per second (m/s) in 1 miles per hour (mph). To convert mph to m/s, use the exact conversion factor 0.44704.

faqs.question: How do I convert miles per hour to meters per second manually?
faqs.answer: Multiply your miles per hour value by 0.44704 (exact factor: 0.44704). For example, 50 mph × 0.44704 = 22.352 m/s.

faqs.question: What is 80 mph in m/s?
faqs.answer: 80 miles per hour (mph) equals 35.7632 meters per second (m/s).
